method: The unrotated pattern uses Bjorklund's repeated-subtraction construction, initialized with k one-step groups and n−k zero-step groups, then recursively pairs the groups until either collection has at most one entry. Positive rotation moves that many trailing steps to the front. Onsets are one-based; inter-onset intervals include the wrap-around gap. Zero and full-density patterns are supported. Inputs are limited to 1–32 steps, 0–32 onsets and rotation below the step count, with strict integer parsing and cross-field checks. No storage, uploads or network access.

sources.title: Godfried T. Toussaint, The Euclidean Algorithm Generates Traditional Musical Rhythms (2005)
